rules: coding-agents = software engineering/coding agents; general multi-agent frameworks = ai-agents
vector DBs stay in vector-db (not rag)
local-ai = local/offline UIs and runtimes (Ollama, Open WebUI, llama.cpp)—not everything self-hostable
research = research/paper implementations—not every ML library

corrections.name: llama.cpp
corrections.reason: Rule explicitly lists llama.cpp as a local/offline runtime; inference engine role stays secondary.

corrections.name: Transformers
corrections.reason: Shared model zoo/library, not paper-code research; research category is for research implementations.

corrections.name: Flax
corrections.reason: General JAX neural-net library (ML framework), not a paper implementation; closer to infrastructure than research.

corrections.name: mcp-agent
corrections.reason: Agent/workflow orchestration framework that uses MCP; not an MCP server/SDK (mcp-tools).

corrections.name: Vane
corrections.reason: Self-hosted AI search/answering product is a RAG app; local-ai is for local UIs/runtimes, not every self-hosted AI app.

corrections.name: wandb
corrections.reason: Core product is MLOps/experiment tracking (peer to MLflow); evaluation notes already marked partial fit.

corrections.name: semantic-conventions
corrections.reason: Telemetry naming standards for GenAI spans/attributes—observability infrastructure, not an evaluation framework.

corrections.name: MaxText
corrections.reason: High-performance LLM pretraining codebase/recipes; training is the primary job, research is secondary context.

corrections.name: LitGPT
corrections.reason: From-scratch LLM implementations with pretrain/finetune/deploy recipes—practitioner training toolkit more than paper artifact.

corrections.name: Grounded-SAM-2
corrections.reason: Grounding DINO + Florence-2 + SAM 2 segmentation/tracking pipeline; vision editing stack, not a VLM multimodal model.

corrections.name: MovieGenBench
corrections.reason: Official notes: benchmarks only (no Movie Gen model weights); evaluation is the primary artifact.

corrections.name: Dify
corrections.reason: Remove local-ai: self-hostable platform ≠ local/offline UI/runtime category.

corrections.name: InstructLab
corrections.reason: Remove local-ai: taxonomy/synthetic-data CLI is not a local AI UI/runtime.

corrections.name: Axolotl
corrections.reason: Remove local-ai: fine-tuning framework running on GPUs is not a local AI UI/runtime.

corrections.name: bitsandbytes
corrections.reason: Remove local-ai: quantization library dependency, not a local AI UI/runtime.

corrections.name: LLaMA-Factory
corrections.reason: Remove local-ai: training toolkit with optional WebUI ≠ local-ai runtimes like Ollama/Open WebUI.

corrections.name: Open WebUI
corrections.reason: Remove ai-agents: ChatGPT-style local UI with tools/MCP is not an agent framework (avoid LLM→agent inflation).

corrections.name: Whisper
corrections.reason: Remove multimodal: Whisper is speech recognition (audio-ai); multimodal reserved for cross-modal VLMs/etc.

corrections.name: AudioCraft
corrections.reason: Remove multimodal: MusicGen/EnCodec are audio generation; multimodal secondary was category inflation.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: LangChain
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Equally an agent framework, but RAG primitives remain a defining use-case and LangGraph already covers orchestration under ai-agents; left as RAG peer to LlamaIndex/Haystack.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: smolagents
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Code-acting agents write/run code as an action space, but the library is a general agent framework—not a software-engineering coding agent product. Kept in ai-agents.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: Open Interpreter
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: General local code-execution agent vs SE-specific coding agent; retained in coding-agents given code-centric product positioning and local open-model focus.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: Meilisearch
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Primarily a full-text/hybrid search engine that added vectors; kept in vector-db because hybrid retrieval is how it enters AI stacks, with infrastructure already secondary.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: helicone
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Gateway/observability platform; evaluation category in this directory intentionally holds LLMOps eval+tracing tools (alongside Langfuse/Phoenix). Not moved with wandb.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: langfuse
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Tracing + evals + prompt management; same editorial bucket as other LLM observability/eval suites. Borderline with infrastructure but left with peers.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: MLX
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: General Apple Silicon array framework, but directory framing is LLM/local inference path (with mlx-lm). Left as llm-inference rather than infrastructure.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: GPT-NeoX
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Large-scale training codebase, but historically a research/open-LM artifact (Eleuther). Unlike MaxText/LitGPT, kept under research.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: Tabby
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Self-hosted autocomplete/chat assistant more than autonomous coding agent; coding-agents category here includes IDE coding assistants, so left unchanged.

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: chat-ui
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Self-hosted HuggingChat UI often backed by remote HF Inference—not strictly local/offline—but kept with other ChatGPT-clone clients (NextChat/Chatbox).

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: LibreChat
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Product has first-class agents; secondary ai-agents retained (contrast Open WebUI where agent secondary was removed as weaker).

borderlineLeftUnchanged.name: Vespa
borderlineLeftUnchanged.note: Full search/ranking platform beyond pure vector DB; left in vector-db for AI retrieval/hybrid role, infrastructure secondary.
